frontmatter.name: Contoso Onboarding (model Hive)
frontmatter.channel: None. This model Hive is a published snapshot with no live shared copy, so there is nowhere to send a join request.

body:
A synthetic model Hive, like a model home: Contoso and its people are invented, and every key is
a public test key that anyone can re-derive, so it proves nothing. Avery founded it. Its root
commit and founder fingerprint come from the example history in kody-w/rapp-model-hive at commit
2bd7c95. It has no live shared copy and takes no members: read its reviewed public copy, or walk
through the whole Hive in that repository.
